question: What is the name of the initiative launched by the Ministry of Panchayati Raj to develop gender-sensitive governance at the grassroots level?
solution:
The Correct Answer is ​__**Model Women-Friendly Gram Panchayats (MWFGP)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Model Women-Friendly Gram Panchayats Initiative to be Launched at National Convention on 5th March 2025, in New Delhi.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• The **Ministry of Panchayati Raj** will launch the **Model Women-Friendly Gram Panchayats (MWFGP)** initiative at a **National Convention** on **5th March 2025** at **Vigyan Bhawan**, **New Delhi**.
 
• This initiative aims to establish at least **one Model Women-Friendly Gram Panchayat** in each district, focusing on **gender-sensitive** and **girl-friendly governance** practices.
 
• Key highlights include:
 
 
• **Virtual inauguration** of training for **Elected Representatives** and officials of Gram Panchayats.
 
• Launch of a **Monitoring Dashboard** to track progress.
 
• Presentations on the concept and **best practices** for **Women-Friendly Gram Panchayats**.
 
• Screening of **Informational Videos** showcasing successful initiatives in Panchayats.
 
 
 
• Following the National Convention, **Mahila Gram Sabhas** will be organized across India on **8th March 2025**, coinciding with **International Women’s Day**, marking the grassroots-level launch of the initiative.
